**T8.** d=1 grid sweep. The unmatched column reproduces the apparent monotone trend; the matched column restricts to pairs with comparable fit quality (min pair R² ∈ [0.99, 1.0]) so that grid is the only thing differing.

Correlations over all 173 usable pairs: corr(log₂ grid, h-vs-affine) = **+0.2899**, corr(min pair R², h-vs-affine) = **-0.4400**. Monotone within the matched band: **False**.
